fiesta.title: Fiesta Gastro Cafe
fiesta.summary: A trilingual restaurant platform, from the public site to the data behind it.
description: Fiesta Gastro Cafe needed more than a website: one place to present the restaurant and to keep the menu up to date without touching code, in Romanian, Russian and English.
I built the backend as a Django REST API on PostgreSQL and the interface as a React front end that consumes it, then deployed the whole thing behind Nginx on a Linux server.
fiesta.role: Full-stack development — data model, API, interface and deployment.

vm-ai.title: VM.AI
vm-ai.summary: A seven-stage machine learning pipeline built for Moldova's national AI olympiad.
description: VM.AI is a seven-stage machine learning pipeline built for ONIA 2026, Moldova's national AI olympiad. Each stage takes the output of the previous one, from raw data to a scored result.
I built the stage runner and the data handling, and packaged the pipeline so it can be run and reproduced outside the competition.
